$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：廉貞七殺坐丑未，《深造講義》p.144。

basis.quote: 须分别其为奋发，抑或刚戾

rules.text: 你的廉貞七殺在未，會｛昌曲｝又見祿，而不見煞星：成雄宿乾元格，歷盡艱辛而成大業。
rules.en: Your Lian Zhen–Qi Sha sits in Wei, meets ｛Chang or Qu｝, gains Lu and avoids malefics: the 'heroic star' pattern, achieving great things after much hardship.

source.quote: 一般均主历尽艰辛而成大业

rules.text: 你的盤見祿：即使吉凶星並見，你也會奮發。
rules.en: Your chart meets Lu: even with good and bad stars mixed, it points to striving.

source.quote: 有禄而吉凶星曜并见，亦主奋发

rules.text: 你的盤不見祿：即使有輔佐吉星，奮發也有所不足。
rules.en: Your chart doesn't meet Lu: even with supporting stars, the drive to strive falls short.

rules.text: 剛戾的一面較重：剛戾不是指你的脾氣，而是星曜的性質，多表現為六親關係冷淡、人生多波折、多奔波勞碌。
rules.en: The harsh side is stronger: this harshness isn't your temper but the nature of the stars, showing as cool family ties, a life of setbacks and much running about.
rules.edit: 原句「自身有災病」不入讀者句。

source.quote: 是指星曜的性质而不是指本人的气质

rules.text: 會照的武曲化忌，增加你剛戾的性質。
rules.en: Wu Qu in Obstruction in your trine adds to the harshness.

rules.text: 會照的貪狼化忌無妨：只是人生的波折來得較頻密，幅度不會更大。
rules.en: Tan Lang in Obstruction in your trine does no real harm: setbacks come more often, but not bigger.

source.quote: 仅增加人生波折的频度，而幅度则不增加
